vb_textbox.text: Keep focussed on the screen at all times and keep a finer each on the "s" and "k" keys and your thumbs on the space bar.I did not really see a pattern and so I do not feel like I can guide you as to which gnome to chose only to make sure that you make each of your selections within the allotted time- that way you don't miss out on rounds where points were available.Good luck
